registry.text: Search matches normalized Target substrings using AD-12 NFC, casefold, surrounding Unicode punctuation, collapsed whitespace and apostrophe mapping; diacritics stay significant.
Search matches normalized Russian meaning substrings.
Search spans both Categories of only the requested Language; an empty query lists all its Items.
Search reads only exact Prefix-scoped note types, sends no user text in Anki queries, writes nothing and propagates Anki failures.
Item list rows expose read-only hasAudio metadata derived from the stored Audio field, without altering ItemContent or audio.
Phone and desktop Items show full-row links with Target, Russian meaning, Category and an audio indicator only for rows with Reference audio; a result opens detail.
Language-scoped live search is debounced and a late earlier response cannot replace the newest query results.
The Items list shows a loading skeleton while its read is pending and then shows the results.
An empty collection hides search and shows No English Items yet / Items are made from Captures.; searching a populated list with no matches shows No English Items match followed by the query.
A failed list read shows an inline alert with Try again; retry reads again and replaces the error with results.

Item detail edits Category fields and Save changes posts the existing ItemId and audio=keep through existing Save; only explicit Save commits, then dirty state clears. The adapter updates the existing note preserving Card identities, scheduling, review histories and audio.
Opening an Item again re-reads current Anki values including direct edits, rather than using the list or a prior editor buffer.

Changing Target rechecks duplicates before Save with the existing ItemId excluded; Cancel preserves edits and a changed Target is rechecked; Create anyway updates the edited Item under its original identity.
Duplicate Open existing uses the router unsaved-changes alert; Keep editing preserves the buffer and Discard opens the matched Item without saving the edited Item.
Failed Save preserves local edits and dirty state with prior Anki values and audio unchanged; retry saves the same ItemId, and leaving unsaved edits uses the router Keep editing / Discard guard.

limitations: API cases AC-1..AC-4 and AC-6 fail on missing list route (404); AC-5 fails on absent scoped queries. Assertions after those failures must be rechecked during implementation.

AC-7 and AC-9 fail on their criterion assertions: missing row and loading skeleton. Other browser cases stop at absent search, error-state or editable-detail prerequisites. Their deeper debounce, duplicate, freshness and retry transitions are scaffolded, not independently verified yet.
The desktop branch of AC-7 is not reached until the phone branch passes; French/Sentence editor variants are green-phase work.
Actual review histories and scheduling require released-wheel evidence in story 5.3.
